scope: Public Help Center article retrieval and search previews, no authenticated runtime.

registry_audit.meaning: Registry status is a recorded claim, not an independent revalidation of all historical URLs.

import_field_matrix.note: Importer taxonomy includes Task links; do not treat this as an additional general property type.

contracts.documented_behavior: Choose file and destination, set date/delimiter, review suggested field mapping and invalid cell values before running. Mappings may reuse previous structural matches across users.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test locale, duplicate source IDs, hierarchy references, permission to create schema, and explicit disclosure of unmapped columns.

contracts.documented_behavior: Queue and running states can be canceled; result has completion or failure status and drill-down by entity, actor and operation ID.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test partial import, cancellation race, retry without duplicate entities, report authorization; rollback not established.

contracts.documented_behavior: Import maps cell values rather than workbook formatting. Computed, attachment and relational fields are unsupported; comments, image objects and rich presentation do not survive.
contracts.proposed_qa: Show preflight loss report; distinguish omitted property from empty value, and preserve raw source for reconciliation.

contracts.documented_behavior: Docx, HTML and Markdown can be imported; HTML splitting is an option and HTML has a 10 MB cap. Protected destination and role capabilities constrain import.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test headings and nested pages, tables, unsupported embeds, file size, formatting and external references.

contracts.documented_behavior: CSV exports are scoped to selected locations. Docs export selected or all pages into HTML, PDF or Markdown; embeds excluded and emailed download links expire after one hour.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test access, consistent snapshot, stable identifiers, attachment download and missing links; do not equate export to complete backup.

contracts.documented_behavior: Recoverable deleted items have 30-day window. Restore is individual. Deleted container contents are nested under container; some views, comments and individually deleted attachments cannot be recovered.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test delete versus archive, permission, container restore, multi-list identity, permanent delete warning and expiry.

contracts.documented_behavior: Vendor reports automatic region-local encrypted backups for disaster recovery only, retained up to one year; item-level restore unavailable.
contracts.proposed_qa: Define separate self-service restore and disaster recovery policies; verify restore drill, RPO/RTO and export fidelity independently.

contracts.documented_behavior: Global search starts with recents, then relevance-ranked results. Pinned object/source filters, creator/assignee/location/status/type and archive controls; results expose open, new tab and copy-link actions, keyboard equivalents. AI can assist after no results.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test focus restoration, no results versus access denied, stale index, query history, source label and keyboard shortcuts.

contracts.documented_behavior: Internal links require membership and object access; public links have different routes, and enterprise auth settings can require sign-in.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test public versus internal copy, revoke access, unauthenticated user, custom IDs, expired share and no permission leakage.

contracts.documented_behavior: Session-duration policy can force all active users to sign out when changing from never-expire. Idle timeout offers continuation five minutes before expiry.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test confirmation, preservation of unsaved work, multi-tab activity, reauthentication and policy changes.

contracts.documented_behavior: Optional or required SSO, policy-specific 2FA and administrator-assisted recovery; default policy differs from enforced policy.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test enrollment, lockout, recovery, revocation and cross-tenant scope; don't infer cryptographic assurance from UI.

contracts.documented_behavior: Global chat retention can be overridden per conversation type; daily cleanup also removes child replies. Audit history has separate 60-day limit.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test inheritance, time-based deletion, admin permissions, audit trail and legal retention policy. Separate chat cleanup from backup lifecycle.
